app.name: PictoChat
app.short_description: Chat on PictoChat Online from your Wii.
app.long_description:
A Wii client for PictoChat Online (https://pict.chat) by ayunami2000: join the chat rooms, write with the DS keyboards and draw with the Wii Remote pointer, just like PictoChat on the Nintendo DS.
PictoChat Online asks for a captcha before you join. The app shows a code: solve the captcha on your phone or computer at pictocard.net/pictochat and your Wii joins the chat.
Works with the Wii Remote (pointer and buttons), Classic Controller, GameCube controller, Wii U GamePad and Pro Controller, DualShock 3, a USB mouse and a USB keyboard.
Public rooms are public and logged. Needs an Internet connection.
